d: Anant Singh Daughter Wedding : bihar ke mokama vidhayak anant kumar sinh ki beti shivangi ke tilak samaroh ki rasmen shukravar ko shuru ho gaeen. barh ke nadvan ganv men parivar ki mahilaon ne manglik git gakar tilak-chumavan ki rasm puri ki. is dauran shivangi ke chhote bhaee abhinav bhi maujud rahe. abhinav ka janeoo sanskar bhi hona hai. tilak samaroh ke lie parivar ne kaee dinon se taiyariyan ki thin. mehmanon ke svagat ke lie kaee tarah ki mithaiyan banvaee gaee hain. inmen 1000 kilo shuddh ghi ke laddu bhi shamil hain.
